review_note: The order's title says only 'Weather'. It was signed April 2, 2025 ahead of a days-long severe weather outbreak with tornadoes and flooding forecast, per the Governor's announcement as reported by WKYT and WUKY that day.

The order's title says 'Continuing Weather Event'. 'Continuing' describes the storm, not an extension: this is the original declaration for the May 16, 2025 severe storms and tornadoes (London and Laurel County), per the Kentucky Lantern and WBIR reports of the declaration that day.
